limitations: One complete original generalized cabbage head, one type only. No cultivar, species, color, size, separate leaf or stalk counts. No old pot, plant, leaf or food mesh copied or extracted.

Single closed connected surface with broad wrapped-leaf boundaries, shallow folded lips, thick midrib relief and smaller branching veins. The exterior leaf boundaries are sculptural relief on shared topology, not independently layered sheets or an intersecting sphere-and-leaves assembly. No internal duplicate faces or buried surfaces.

Approximate authored head width0.25m; exact dimensions, underside stalk, concealed leaf backs and internal anatomy were not observed and are generalized. Closed underside is explicitly approximate. No botanical identification, biological reconstruction, food safety or edible-use claim.

Three decreasing LODs, BLEND/GLB/FBX, nine reimports, native/export self-intersection checks and35actual renders. Unlabeled128px oblique views judged to read as a cabbage from its round wrapped-leaf head, broad folds and branching veins; assistant judgment, not audience testing. No game-engine validation.
Valid per-face planar UVs overlap by design; this is not a unique bake atlas. Plain materials without image textures, source artwork, labels or brands.
